name: DR4 Checker by Construct Computer
tagline: Your Ahrefs DR probably drops on Dec 1. See where it lands.
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt, Ankush here, cofounder of Construct Computer 👋 On November 5 Ahrefs announced DR4, a new Domain Rating model that goes live on December 1. I wanted to know what it would do to our own site, so I built a checker that asks Ahrefs' API for both versions and shows them side by side. Our own website https://construct.computer goes from 41 to 11, which stung us a bit.
